audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Yone on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet levelChart read Yone/Yone/Yone/Yone/Azir/Azir/Azir — three rows rendering two answers, with whys under them describing Azir winning.
audit.why: 46.23% over 1168 games is Yone-favoured overall but the level-6 flip is real: Emperor's Divide is terrain and stops both the Mortal Steel knockup dash and the Fate Sealed blink.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side moved to Azir to match win[4..6]; all seven whys rewritten with Yone's real ranges and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text described the first item as 'Lich Bane or Shard of True Ice into core mythic-tier item' — placeholder phrasing that names no real build, and contradicts the page's own Itemization section (Nashor's Tooth rush).
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 7: name the actual item or drop the clause. report[8].t on this same matchup says Nashor's Tooth into Sorcerer's.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Nashor's Tooth into Sorcerer's Shoes and states why the spike matters against a 450-range walk-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Soul Unbound (E) as a gap-closing dash — 'His E-Q all-in dash', 'E-Q all-ins', 'E-in threat'. It is not a dash. Spirit Cleave was never mentioned at all, and the packet flags that the matchup 'never names any of Yone's abilities'.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit' — 22/19/16/13/10s, no dash flag. The dash is Mortal Steel (Q) at 2 Gathering Storm stacks, 450 range, 4s. Spirit Cleave (W) is a 700-range cone that shields him on 14s. Fate Sealed (R) blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound reframed as a move-speed step-in that snaps him back to his body; the knockup dash correctly attributed to the second Mortal Steel stack; Spirit Cleave's 14s shield and 700 cone now stated.

audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22s, Mortal Steel 4s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Azir E 22s all stated at rank 1.

edits.before: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — your auto range is the soldier's range. Don't poke yet; sand costs mana.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is 450 range on a 4s cooldown. W behind the wave, farm through the soldier, and spend no mana on poke.

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Two soldiers let you drag a Q through him, but his second Mortal Steel stack is a knockup dash — trade and step off.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: E is your shield-dash out. Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — that is the window he wants, so keep sand between you.

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Yone on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: Drag Qs through his last-hit steps, but Spirit Cleave shields on 14s and cleaves at 700 — stay out of the cone.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is terrain: it stops the Mortal Steel knockup dash and the Fate Sealed blink. The maths flip here.

edits.before: Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred. Shove crashes and rotate — the soldiers siege towers better than any mid.
edits.after: Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred. Crash waves and make him walk 450 range through sand to reach you.

edits.before: Full build Azir is a teamfight: R cuts the fight in half, soldiers melt whoever is on your side of the wall.
edits.after: Full build your wall splits him off his team, and a Fate Sealed that lands inside your soldiers is a dead Yone.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yone walks in on Soul Unbound's move speed, knocks you up with his second Mortal Steel stack, and finishes before your E is back.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1: survive the spirit window and punish the body it snaps him back to. - Mortal Steel is 4s and Spirit Cleave 14s, so his shield is not always there. - E Shifting Sands is 22s and it is the lifeline, never chip damage.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Land the soldier auto as the waves meet, then step off his 450 line before his second Mortal Steel stack lands.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Yone on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Shifting Sands is 22 seconds at rank 1 and it is the only thing that gets you out of a Mortal Steel knockup. Spend it on his commit, never to add damage to a poke trade.

edits.before: Yone whiffs Soul Unbound and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide is terrain — it stops his dash mid-flight.

edits.before: That is Yone’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Standing still is the Mortal Steel knockup he needs to start it.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Yone player is waiting for.
edits.after: R is 120 seconds at rank 1. Spend it on the Mortal Steel dash that actually commits, not on a poke jab through minions.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, siege: crash with soldier autos, take plates while Soul Unbound's 22 seconds is down, and rotate with R held to wall off his dive.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through siege — soldiers take plates, and Emperor's Divide is terrain that stops the Mortal Steel dash and Fate Sealed blink.

edits.before: If Yone opens the score, reset expectations and respect Soul Unbound doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Yone opens the score, buy Zhonya's early and count Soul Unbound's 22 seconds before every step forward. After a second, your job is soldier-range farm and wave control.

edits.before: His E-Q all-in dash punishes any Azir soldier setup before level 6, keeping the lane on his terms
edits.after: His Mortal Steel knockup dash punishes any Azir soldier setup before level 6, keeping the lane on his terms

edits.before: Yone hits level 3 and starts looking for E-Q all-ins through your soldier zone; his knockup dash lets him ignore your spacing tools for one commit and he trades favorably if you're pushed.
edits.after: Yone hits level 3 and looks for all-ins through your soldier zone: Soul Unbound closes the gap and his second Mortal Steel stack is a knockup dash, so he ignores your spacing for one commit and trades well if you're pushed.

edits.before: Once you finish your first completed item (Lich Bane or Shard of True Ice into core mythic-tier item) your soldier waveclear and poke damage jump hard, letting you shove and roam while he still has to walk up.
edits.after: Once you finish your first item — Nashor's Tooth into Sorcerer's Shoes — your soldier waveclear and poke damage jump hard, letting you shove and roam while he still has to walk 450 range through sand to reach you.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are rough — Yone's Q spam and E-in threat force you to play passively and you can't out-damage him in a straight trade; hug your soldiers and don't overextend. It only gets worse levels 3-5 as his knockup dash punishes any greedy cast animation, and his passive crit stacks add up fast if you tunnel farming instead of watching his cooldowns.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are rough — Mortal Steel spam and the Soul Unbound step-in force you to play passively and you can't out-damage him in a straight trade; hug your soldiers and don't overextend. It gets worse levels 3-5 as his second Mortal Steel stack knocks you up through any greedy cast animation, and Spirit Cleave shields him every 14 seconds if you tunnel on farming instead of his cooldowns.
